identity_notes: Late winter — YY ate the carry-half ramp shoot at the treehouse last night; the inventory is empty again.
Yesterday: dug up the year's first ramp shoot from the hidden warm patch and brought half home.

Today: the brook surged brown after an upstream icejam broke; YY went paws-out at the eddy and rescued a cluster of soaked beechnuts. One kernel was good and ate it on the spot. The half-cold from the dive is sitting in his chest tonight.
Standing thread: the warm patch is still hidden; the brook only carries once.
